# 👁️‍ Mission & Vision

I am a soil biogeochemist with experience in research, teaching and stakeholder engagement, working at the soil-plant-water nexus. My passion and expertise are in soil organic matter chemistry, carbon stabilization in managed grasslands, isotope tracing and molecular spectroscopy, combined with reproducible data analysis and clear communication to producers, policy makers and students. I aim to lead an independent research program on climate-sensitive carbon retention and nutrient cycling in agricultural soils, co-designed with the people who manage the land.

## 🎓Education

-   Ph.D., Environmental Sciences. University of Guelph, Canada. 2023. Thesis: *Molecular characterization of recalcitrant soil organic matter in an organic soil profile* (advisor: Prof. Paul Voroney).

-   MBA. University of Bedfordshire, United Kingdom. 2024. Thesis on ethical leadership and employee motivation in multinational companies.

-   M.Sc., Floriculture and Landscape Architecture. Postgraduate Institute of Agriculture, University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka. 2017 (GPA 3.92/4.00, ranked first).

-   B.Sc., Agricultural Technology and Management. University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka. 2015 (GPA 3.74/4.00, batch top).

-   CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants), strategic level. Wisdom Business Academy, Colombo. 2011.

## 🌱Interests

Soil Carbon \| Isotope Tracing \| Molecular Spectroscopy \| Managed Grasslands \| Soil Health

A handful of soil hides a whole story of transformations underneath. Curiosity about what persists, what is lost and why drives my work with producers, students and colleagues.

-   **Research**: Molecular-level chemistry of soil organic matter; carbon stabilization, nutrient retention and water function in pasture and forage systems; recalcitrant and condensed aromatic carbon; nitrogen use efficiency.

-   **Extension**: Field days, keynotes and producer-facing reports that turn isotope and spectroscopy data into grazing, defoliation and nitrogen management decisions.

-   **Education**: Sustainable agricultural systems, soil fertility, experimental design and statistics, soil spectroscopy and isotope biogeochemistry, climate change governance.

# 👨‍🔬 Research Experience

## Postdoctoral Research Scholar

### Sep 2023 - Present

<i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill"></i> Department of Plant Agriculture, University of Guelph, Ontario, Canada.

*Description*: I lead the isotope, fractionation and spectroscopy components of a multi-site managed-forage research program on carbon stabilization, nutrient retention and water regulation in Ontario pasture and grazing systems. I designed and executed ¹³CO₂ pulse-chase labelling experiments (Spring and Fall 2025), coordinated repeated harvests and sample processing, developed mixed-model analyses of carbon allocation across shoots, roots and soil, and developed NMR and DRIFTS protocols to compare soil organic carbon chemistry under adaptive multi-paddock grazing and other land uses. I supported the implementation of CFI/John R. Evans Leaders Fund infrastructure (elemental analyser, root washer, ball mill) and deliver results to producers, industry partners and OMAFA collaborators. Supervisors: Dr. Kimberley Schneider and Dr. Adam Gillespie.

## Graduate Research Assistant / Ph.D. Candidate

### May 2018 - Aug 2023

<i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill"></i> School of Environmental Sciences, University of Guelph, Ontario, Canada.

Conceptualised and implemented a seven-step molecular characterisation framework (solid-state and solution-state NMR, DRIFTS, FTIR, HF and NaOH extraction, NEXAFS and ¹⁴C tracing) for stable soil organic matter in an organic soil profile. Produced first-author papers in *Scientific Reports* and *Applied Geochemistry* and presented at EGU, AGU, the World Congress of Soil Science and CSSS. Supervisor: Prof. Paul Voroney.
